purpose: Replicate the checkpoint 22E4 frozen comparison on the full non held out adult pool, under the same unchanged checkpoint 22D selection gates, because the recorded no_selection rested on 34 positive threshold tuning opportunities and a difference of two flags. This contract enlarges the participant sample and changes nothing else. It cannot establish pronunciation correctness, acceptable language variety, Australian performance, scientific validity, product readiness or a clinical conclusion. A documented no-selection remains a correct completed outcome.

what_changed_from_version_1_0_0: the participant sample grew from 8 to 77 development adults and from 4 to 25 threshold tuning adults, which is every non held out adult in the corpus
the SpeechOcean clip count grew from 480 to 2280, of which 2040 are adult clips
the Azure lane is sent the powered adult sample in both locales rather than 240 clips
the Azure resource moved from the free tier to standard so the run is not truncated by a monthly free allowance
what_did_not_change: the threshold search and selection procedure
the alignment, tie break and abstention rules
the truth definition, the four of five consensus and the unscorable scope
the candidate set and every candidate's role
the excluded lanes and the reasons they are excluded
the split assignments and the sealed held out participants
the two exact repeats and the zero numeric tolerance
replication_declaration.gate_evidence: Three of the five original SpeechOcean762 reviewers pass every gate on both partitions when each is scored as though the reviewer were the candidate system, so the gates sit at roughly competent human level and no result licenses lowering one.

input_policy.relation_class_note: the only class the frozen gates use and the only class checkpoint 22E4 scored; the checkpoint 22D insertion and aggregate exact substitution classes are unchanged historical evidence and are not part of this replication

truth_policy.unit: one expected consonant target identified by clip, word index and target index
truth_policy.positive: four or more of the five original reviewers recorded a coarse relation concern at that target
truth_policy.negative: four or more of the five original reviewers confirmed the expected phone
truth_policy.unscorable: disputed reviewers, unsupported phone class, post-vocalic r, or a target outside the frozen consonant scope
truth_policy.truth_extraction_proof: the powered truth extractor reproduces all 5,478 committed checkpoint 22D relation rows exactly on the frozen sample before it may write the powered rows

selection_gates.expert_agreement_band_role: the roughly 0.55 to 0.65 phone level expert agreement correlation reported around SpeechOcean762 is expectation calibration only

threshold_policy.applies_to: every candidate whose decision rule exposes a continuous concern score
threshold_policy.candidate_thresholds: every distinct authoritative concern score observed across the two allowed adult partitions, plus one point above the observed maximum so the empty positive set is always examined
threshold_policy.selection: highest tuning recall meeting every development and tuning gate, then highest tuning precision, then highest threshold
threshold_policy.closest_point_reporting_rule: most frozen gate checks passed, then highest worst partition precision, then recall, then fewest false positives

free_phone_lanes.reference_expansion: frozen ARPAbet to IPA phone map, diphthongs expanded to their declared parts
free_phone_lanes.out_of_inventory_definition: an observed token that is neither a frozen reference IPA token, a declared equivalent, a declared unsupported candidate detail nor a special nonphone; this applies the frozen phone map claim that an unknown candidate phone is unscorable

external_score_lanes.position_matching: per reference word, align this project's ARPAbet reference phones against the provider's returned expected phones using the same deterministic unit cost algorithm and tie break order
external_score_lanes.comparison_form: normalized IPA string per reference phone, NFD, with tie bars, length marks, primary and secondary stress removed
external_score_lanes.target_scorable_only_when: the target aligns one to one with a provider expected phone whose normalized string is identical
external_score_lanes.word_error_type_role: recorded separately as provider word miscue evidence; it never creates or suppresses a phone level concern

candidates.concern_score: negated GOP-AF log posterior over the substitution lattice
negated GOP-AF-SD log posterior over the substitution and deletion lattice
candidates.checkpoint_22e4_result: strongest candidate at eight of ten checks; passed all five development gates and failed tuning precision at 0.667 against 0.75

candidates.concern_score: one hundred minus the provider phoneme accuracy score
one hundred minus the provider phoneme accuracy score
candidates.locale_limitation: this locale emits every phone name key as an empty string, so it can raise a concern but can never name a produced phone
candidates.powered_at_full_scale_reason: checkpoint 22E4 found this locale named zero of 5,302 phone positions and therefore produced no scorable evidence. Data minimisation would allow a smaller confirmation, but the owner decided on 2026-07-27 that every eligible lane receives the same powered sample, so that no lane can be described as having been reduced after it failed to produce evidence.

baseline_reference.role: checkpoint 22D local baseline for incremental value only
